x-changelog.description:
There are two new query parameters: `filter` and `sort`.
The `filter` query parameter will allow the user to filter by open, closed, or hidden bid packages.
The `sort` query parameter accepts the following values:
  - number
  - title
  - bid_due_date
  - invited_bids_count
  - bids_will_bid_count
  - submitted_bids_count
  - status

These query parameters will only take affect when view is set to internal.

Adds the `has_bid_forms` filter to the bid packages index endpoint. This filter will allow the user to retrieve only bid packages that have bid forms.

This filter parameter will only take affect when view is set to either internal or use_previous_bidders.
Sorting by title ignores accents
Filtering bid packages by available features (e.g., flexible_response_types_enabled, bid_form_sections_enabled)

x-changelog.summary: Added public discovery and PCN classification fields
x-changelog.description:
Added new fields to bid package list responses:
- `enable_public_discovery`: Boolean flag for public bid package discoverability
- `primary_slug_with_ids`: Primary public slug with company ID and bid package ID prefix (format: {company_id}_{bid_package_id}_{slug}, auto-generated from title)
- `pre_bid_meeting_location`: Location for the pre-bid meeting
- `pre_bid_meeting_date`: Date and time for the pre-bid meeting
- `pre_bid_meeting_online_link`: Online meeting link for the pre-bid meeting
- `pre_bid_meeting_notes`: Notes for the pre-bid meeting
- `public_project_funding_source`: Source of funding for the public project, either 'private' or 'public'
- `show_location_for_nda_projects`: Whether the location for the NDA project is shown
- `public_bid_opening_details_date`: Date and time for the public bid opening
- `public_bid_opening_details_location`: Location for the public bid opening
- `public_bid_opening_details_online_link`: Online link for the public bid opening
- `trades_and_services`: Array of PCN trade classifications with trade_level, trade_path, and trade_key
- `business_classifications`: Array of business classifications with classification_name, classification_abbreviation, and classification_key
Added `has_pdm_documents` boolean to indicate if a bid package has any PDM documents.
Adds support for filtering Bid Packages by "created_at" (datetime) query parameter. Supports ISO 8601 date-time format and range syntax (e.g. 2024-01-01T00:00:00Z...2024-12-31T23:59:59Z).
Adds support for filtering Bid Packages by "bid_due_date" (datetime) query parameter. Supports ISO 8601 date-time format and range syntax.

Adds support for filtering Bid Packages by status via the "filters[status]" query parameter. Accepted values are 'open', 'closed', and 'hidden'. When omitted, recycle-bin (hidden) bid packages are excluded by default.

The "created_at" (date-time) field is now included in the response for each Bid Package when using the internal view (view=internal). This enables consumers such as the Data Extracts UI to display the Date Created column.

Adds support for filtering Bid Packages by bid form presence via the "filters[has_bid_forms]" boolean query parameter. When true, only bid packages that have bid forms are returned; when false, only bid packages without bid forms are returned. This filter is independent of the status filter and can be combined with it.

x-changelog.summary: Added public discovery and PCN classification fields
x-changelog.description:
Added new fields to request body and response:
- `enable_public_discovery`: Boolean flag for public bid package discoverability
- `pre_bid_meeting_location`: Location for the pre-bid meeting
- `pre_bid_meeting_date`: Date and time for the pre-bid meeting
- `pre_bid_meeting_online_link`: Online meeting link for the pre-bid meeting
- `pre_bid_meeting_notes`: Notes for the pre-bid meeting
- `public_project_funding_source`: Source of funding for the public project, either 'private' or 'public'
- `show_location_for_nda_projects`: Whether to show location for NDA projects
- `public_bid_opening_details_date`: Date and time for the public bid opening
- `public_bid_opening_details_location`: Location for the public bid opening
- `public_bid_opening_details_online_link`: Online link for the public bid opening
- `trades_and_services`: Array of PCN trade classifications with trade_level, trade_path, and trade_key
- `business_classifications`: Array of business classifications with classification_name, classification_abbreviation, and classification_key

Added to response only:
- `primary_slug_with_ids`: Primary public slug with company ID and bid package ID prefix (format: {company_id}_{bid_package_id}_{slug}, auto-generated from title)

x-changelog.summary: Added lock fields for unit and quantity
x-changelog.description:
Added 4 new lock fields to bid packages: lock_unit_fields_base_bid, lock_quantity_fields_base_bid,
lock_unit_fields_alternates, and lock_quantity_fields_alternates. These fields allow solicitors
to set global lock settings for unit and quantity fields.

x-changelog.summary: Separated Pre-Bid Meeting and Public Bid Opening fields into new feature flag
x-changelog.description:
Pre-Bid Meeting and Public Bid Opening fields are now controlled by a separate feature flag (`bidding-show-pre-bid-and-public-opening-fields`), independent from the `show-public-projects` flag.

Fields affected:
- pre_bid_meeting_date
- pre_bid_meeting_location
- pre_bid_meeting_online_link
- pre_bid_meeting_notes
- public_bid_opening_details_date
- public_bid_opening_details_location
- public_bid_opening_details_online_link

These fields can now be set and returned independently of other Public Projects functionality.

Affected endpoints:
- POST /projects/{project_id}/bid_packages
- PATCH /projects/{project_id}/bid_packages/{id}
- GET /projects/{project_id}/bid_packages/{id}
- GET /projects/{project_id}/bid_packages
- POST /projects/{project_id}/bid_packages/{id}/seal

x-changelog.summary: Added project logo fields in Response
x-changelog.description:
Added two new fields to support project logo display:
- `project_logo_name`: The file name of the project logo (e.g., 'logo.png')
- `project_logo_url`: The URL to access the project logo (e.g., 'http://www.example.com/logo.png'). This will default to the Procore logo if the project does not have a custom logo.

x-changelog.summary: Added public discovery and PCN classification fields
x-changelog.description:
Added new fields to bid package show responses:
- `enable_public_discovery`: Boolean flag for public bid package discoverability
- `primary_slug_with_ids`: Primary public slug with company ID and bid package ID prefix (format: {company_id}_{bid_package_id}_{slug}, auto-generated from title)
- `pre_bid_meeting_location`: Location for the pre-bid meeting
- `pre_bid_meeting_date`: Date and time for the pre-bid meeting
- `pre_bid_meeting_online_link`: Online meeting link for the pre-bid meeting
- `pre_bid_meeting_notes`: Notes for the pre-bid meeting
- `public_project_funding_source`: Source of funding for the public project, either 'private' or 'public'
- `show_location_for_nda_projects`: Whether the location for the NDA project is shown
- `public_bid_opening_details_date`: Date and time for the public bid opening
- `public_bid_opening_details_location`: Location for the public bid opening
- `public_bid_opening_details_online_link`: Online link for the public bid opening
- `trades_and_services`: Array of PCN trade classifications with trade_level, trade_path, and trade_key
- `business_classifications`: Array of business classifications with classification_name, classification_abbreviation, and classification_key
Added `has_pdm_documents` boolean to indicate if a bid package has any PDM documents.

x-changelog.summary: Added lock fields for unit and quantity
x-changelog.description:
Added 4 new lock fields to bid packages: lock_unit_fields_base_bid, lock_quantity_fields_base_bid,
lock_unit_fields_alternates, and lock_quantity_fields_alternates. These fields allow solicitors
to set global lock settings for unit and quantity fields.

x-changelog.summary: Added project logo fields in Response
x-changelog.description:
Added two new fields to support project logo display:
- `project_logo_name`: The file name of the project logo (e.g., 'logo.png')
- `project_logo_url`: The URL to access the project logo (e.g., 'http://www.example.com/logo.png'). This will default to the Procore logo if the project does not have a custom logo.

import http.client

conn = http.client.HTTPSConnection("api.procore.com")

payload = "{\"bid_package\":{\"accept_post_due_submissions\":false,\"bid_due_date\":\"2016-12-13T03:00:00Z\",\"bid_email_message\":\"Procore would like to invite you to bid on new campus\",\"bid_web_message\":\"Please reach out to our help desk if you need assistance with bidding.\",\"title\":\"Procore Sky Campus\",\"accounting_method\":\"unit\",\"bid_submission_confirmation\":\"Your Bid Has Been Successfully Submitted\",\"anticipated_award_date\":\"2016-12-13\",\"number\":\"46\",\"distribution_ids\":[1587816],\"blind_bidding\":false,\"pre_bid_walk_through_date\":\"2016-12-13T03:00:00Z\",\"pre_bid_walk_through_notes\":\"So Many Potential Change Orders\",\"enable_prebid_walkthrough\":true,\"manager_id\":1587816,\"require_nda\":false,\"display_project_name\":true,\"prostore_file_ids\":[12344566],\"enable_public_discovery\":false,\"pre_bid_meeting_location\":\"123 Main St, Conference Room A, Austin, TX 78701\",\"pre_bid_meeting_date\":\"2025-10-20T14:00:00Z\",\"pre_bid_meeting_online_link\":\"https://zoom.us/j/1234567890\",\"pre_bid_meeting_notes\":\"Please bring safety equipment and hard hats\",\"public_project_funding_source\":\"public\",\"show_location_for_nda_projects\":false,\"public_bid_opening_details_date\":\"2025-10-20T14:00:00Z\",\"public_bid_opening_details_location\":\"City Hall, Room 301, Austin, TX 78701\",\"public_bid_opening_details_online_link\":\"https://zoom.us/j/9876543210\",\"trades_and_services\":[{\"trade_level\":\"Division\",\"trade_path\":\"03 - Concrete\",\"trade_key\":\"03000\"}],\"business_classifications\":[{\"classification_name\":\"Small Business\",\"classification_abbreviation\":\"SBE\",\"classification_key\":\"SBE\"}]}}"

headers = { 'content-type': "application/json" }

conn.request("PATCH", "/rest/v1.0/projects/%7Bproject_id%7D/bid_packages/%7Bid%7D", payload, headers)

res = conn.getresponse()
data = res.read()

print(data.decode("utf-8"))
